name: gatekeeper-monorepo
description: Production-quality authorization and feature-flag toolkit for full-stack TypeScript applications

scripts.publish:dry-run: pnpm --filter @ahmed109/gatekeeper-core exec npm pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @ahmed109/gatekeeper-react exec npm pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @ahmed109/gatekeeper-express exec npm pack --dry-run
scripts.publish:packages: pnpm --filter @ahmed109/gatekeeper-core publish --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @ahmed109/gatekeeper-react publish --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @ahmed109/gatekeeper-express publish --access public --no-git-checks
